original_card.question: Can the 64-per-call centre path (eight rank-8 COPY/ERASE totals through the private temporary) be shared across calls or shrunk?
methods: Derive a fully charged favorable relaxation for sharing one centre path across k calls, including restoration, hosting and precision.
Prove a lower bound on copied information per call for the selected decoder contract.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Show the changed centre charge and copy profile per call with every added restoration or hosting cost charged, and its ceiling via ceiling.ceiling(centre=...). A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write the per-call centre charge and copy children for sharing across k = 2 calls, charge the sharing overhead, and screen it; stop this route if even the ideal sharing gains under 10%. Ideal budgets: free 2.80x, shared by two 1.90x (levers.py).
original_card.bottleneck_link: The centre path consumes 64 of about 99.6 unpaid coordinates per call, i.e. about 64% of the raw deficit.
allowed_variations: One sharing pattern across a fixed number of calls.
One reduced copied-total contract for the existing decoder.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Removing copies without a replacement contract for the decoder's copied totals.

Continuing a partial cost improvement while leaving the same unpriced consumer, restoration or central-readout obligation unresolved; refresh the family expansion decision first. Local product-retiming evidence has a narrow scope and is not a ban on changed graphs or contracts.

actual_scope: p=19 coded-reverse supplier: the materialized 223-gate word listing (main data path, including the closing swap) with exact replay at p=2 and p=19, the rank invoice and its charged tail ratios, the field-level bill (77 recodings, zero Gaussian rank), the PR4433 compiler ranks, the admitted BIT saving, the nonrecursive budgets and the strict outer ledger at kappa = 951999/280000000 = 0.0033999964.
scope_change_reason: The p8 package was retracted and the p19 word became the candidate endpoint. Building it showed the recovered p=2 baseline compared independent random initial states, and that with a shared state the obstruction is the stage letter (only the full Gaussian commutes with the code), not the boundary orientation. Once the word was exact, the paid accounting replaced the unbuilt tariff: the rank invoice pops rank 0 and takes no code argument, so the field bill is rank-free and the endpoint is set by the admitted BIT cap.
bottleneck_link: The complex side is no longer binding: the p=19 word prices at 0.007578535 against a frontier of 0.00302015. The endpoint is the admitted BIT saving 0.0034 less the strict-ordering slack, so the complex supplier now has slack and the BIT side is the limiting interface.
stop_rule: Stop after the materialized word, the paid accounting and the claim receipt; do not touch the selected frontier, the compiler interfaces or other packages.
evidence: PASS word: 223 gate records (19 gauge loads, 19 unloads, 19 reverse adds, 19 letters, 20 forwards, 108 bridges, 19 closing swaps), 77 recodings, replay equals the standard word on 0 of 229376 entries at p=2 and 0 of 2179072 at p=19 (dense), with the gauge invariant holding after every gate. PASS code: A = I - MM^T/4, A^-1 = I + (A - I)/13 = I - MM^T/52, A A^-1 = I exact, prefix bounds 57 and 69/13, no recursive Gaussian child. PASS invoice: rank-free code (every port map is a signed address permutation and the scalar program moves no address); the tested saving is derived on the source grid as kappa + 7*gap with gap = 1/1400000000, the raw moment sign there is positive in exact interval arithmetic and in an independent 60-digit decimal engine, positive a step below and negative above the root; at kappa the charged ratios are alpha 0.99579414, gamma 0.963763, delta 0.951561 with both decay blocks under 1/16 and power-1024 tails under 2^-32. PASS bill: 17248 monomial field maps, 68992 scalar adds, 1232 owned clears per call, zero Gaussian rank. PASS compiler: PR4433 power majorant at v=1024 gives H0 = 497275706368 and H1 = 473406216450479105 with the previous threshold rejected; the logarithmic majorant at ambient rank 153 would cap the tested saving at 0.0030566. PASS BIT: atom 0.004 > ordinary 0.0034363538 > admitted 0.0034. PASS budgets: local 4794000 + 158168 < 10^7 and raw 190835072 + field bill 18144000 = 208979072 < 10^9. PASS ledger: every predicate passes at the endpoint and at exactly 0.0034 only actual_bit_above_effective fails. CLAIM kappa 951999/280000000 = 0.0033999964, +12.58% over 60403/20000000 = 0.00302015.
